DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: slaughterhouse
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: Slaughters all live animals in the outpost's warehouse and stores their meat, leather and other butcher products. Yield follows the storyteller's butcher yield setting. Starts paused; use the facility button to start or pause slaughter. Move animals you want to keep out of the outpost before starting.
